BEERE VISHNU SAI
Dharmavaram, Andhra Pradesh | beerevishnusai776600@gmail.com | +91 9182679641
LinkedIn | GitHub | Portfolio
PROFILE SUMMARY
Results-driven Data Analyst fresher with cross-domain analytics experience across EV, healthcare, retail, and
telecom — processing 60,000+ records, reducing reporting time by 60%, and delivering predictive models that
directly inform business strategy. Proficient in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and Excel, with a proven ability
to translate raw datasets into KPI dashboards, self-service reports, and actionable recommendations for
stakeholders. Oracle-certified in Analytics Cloud and Database Services (2025). Backed by 4 GitHub-published
projects spanning descriptive analytics, root cause analysis, and machine learning — each demonstrating the
full DA workflow from data pipeline design to executive insight delivery. Targeting Data Analyst roles at product-
focused MNCs and IT organisations.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming & Querying: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn), SQL (Joins,
Subqueries, Correlated Subqueries, Aggregate Functions, Window Functions)
Data Visualization & BI: Tableau, Power BI (Data Modelling, DAX, Power Query), Advanced Excel (Pivot
Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Power Query, Dynamic Charts)
Data Engineering: MySQL, ETL Pipeline Design, Data Cleaning, Data Validation, Schema Validation, Data
Governance, Data Pipeline Design, Git, GitHub
Analytics Concepts: EDA, Descriptive Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Statistical Analysis, KPI Reporting,
Trend Analysis, Variance Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Dashboard Development, Business Intelligence, Data
Storytelling, Ad-hoc Analysis, Self-Service Reporting, Process Improvement
Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Reporting, As-Is / To-Be Analysis,
Data-Driven Recommendations, Cross-Functional Collaboration
Soft Skills: Analytical Thinking, Problem Solving, Attention to Detail, Stakeholder Communication, Team
Collaboration
WORK EXPERIENCE
Data Analyst Intern
Oct 2025 – Mar 2026
AICTE & APSCHE – SmartInternz (SmartBridge)
GitHub Repository: github.com/Vishnu-Sai-bit/Visualization-Tool-for-Electric-Vehicle-Charge-and-Range-Analysis
• Delivered end-to-end EV charging data analysis — from raw ingestion to executive dashboard deployment
— across a 240-hour, AICTE-recognised Data Analytics internship with SmartBridge / APSCHE.
• Independently designed and executed a full EDA pipeline on 30,000+ EV charging records —
encompassing schema profiling, missing value treatment, duplicate resolution, and statistical pattern
detection — surfacing battery efficiency degradation trends and cutting manual reporting effort by 40% vs
prior Excel-based workflows.
• Owned end-to-end data quality for a 30,000-record production dataset — designing validation and
reconciliation workflows that resolved 1,200+ inconsistencies across null values, duplicate records, and
schema mismatches, raising verified accuracy to >95% before downstream analysis and dashboard
delivery.
• Designed 3 interactive Tableau dashboards tracking 8+ KPIs — enabling self-service reporting that
reduced stakeholder insight extraction time by 60% against prior manual reporting methods.
• Surfaced that charging efficiency declined by ~18% during peak utilisation windows vs off-peak periods
— a cross-variable finding incorporated as a primary KPI segmentation dimension in the final stakeholder
report and dashboard.
Tools: Tableau, Excel, Python, SQL, Git, GitHub
